notes: Safer position syncing: closes and reversals now wait for pending orders to settle, with clear alerts whenever an account needs your attention.
changelog: When the master closes or reverses, each account's own exit orders now finish before anything is sent, so an account can no longer overshoot into the opposite position.
Resting copies of master entries that already filled are cancelled when the master goes flat, so they can't fill later without protection.
Stops and targets for short positions are held until the entry fills, and protective orders are kept when a reversal opens a new position.
Accounts locked by Karma Guardian are closed but not reopened during a reversal, and you get an alert.
New alerts warn you when an account may not match the master, including after Disable or Flatten All.
Open Orders now lists part-filled and pending orders, the window remembers its position, and the splash and risk disclaimer work on every Windows language setting.
